scope: RAW SAMPLE FINDING — six pinned cases only; resource type semantics are not inferred from lexical labels

host.reason: No structured host/node/hostname identifier field exists in any sampled Parquet schema.

pod/container.reason: logs.parquet has a literal container_name column, but no pod UID, container ID, host/node, lifecycle, or telemetry relation that proves an instance-level node.
pod/container.graph_node: No resource node; container_name may remain an attribute of a log row.

database.reason: Metric and container labels contain lexical strings such as -mongo, -mysql, and -db, but the raw schema has no db.system, database identifier, endpoint, connection, or service-to-database relation.
database.graph_node: No database node from this dataset alone.
database.uses_edge: No; an external mapping would be required and must be separately governed.

logical_database.reason: No schema/catalog/database-name field or logical-database identifier occurs in the sampled structured telemetry.

cache.reason: Literal redis/cache strings occur in labels or message text, but there is no cache-specific structured identity, endpoint, or service-to-cache relation.
cache.graph_node: No cache node from this dataset alone.

broker.reason: Literal rabbitmq/broker strings occur in labels or message text, but no broker ID, protocol attribute, producer/consumer field, or relation is present.
broker.graph_node: No broker node from this dataset alone.

queue/topic.reason: No queue name, topic name, producer/consumer, messaging destination, or message key is a structured field. queue-master is only a literal label, not a queue/topic identity.

other.reason: Raw metrics have opaque literal series prefixes and logs have literal container_name values; neither includes a typed resource identity or a runtime USES relationship.
other.graph_node: No typed resource node; an opaque series label may only remain a feature/attribute under an explicit loader rule.

decision_rule.observable_entity: Requires a dedicated structured identity and a dataset-supported relationship; neither may be inferred from a lexical label or free-text message.
decision_rule.attribute_only: A literal raw column or metric-series prefix exists but does not establish a typed, stable runtime resource entity or a USES edge.
decision_rule.requires_external_mapping: Raw lexical labels suggest a type, but semantic type/identity and any relation require information outside the pinned raw data.
decision_rule.not_supported: No structured identifier or relation exists in the pinned raw schemas for the requested type.

re2_tt_pilot_implication.resource_graph: NOT SUPPORTED from the selected RE2-TT raw data; use neither resource nodes nor USES edges in the first pilot.
re2_tt_pilot_implication.allowed: Service/operation trace representation and metric-series features only under separate explicit rules; this script makes no claim that these form resource topology.
